cat > analyze.py <<'PY'
import socket,sys,time
import arena
b=arena.load_board()
s=socket.socket(socket.AF_UNIX,socket.SOCK_STREAM);s.connect('/run/match/opponent-stockfish.sock');f=s.makefile('r')
def send(x):s.sendall((x+'\n').encode())
send('uci')
while 'uciok' not in f.readline():pass
send('setoption name Threads value 2');send('setoption name Hash value 256');send('isready')
while 'readyok' not in f.readline():pass
send('position startpos moves '+' '.join(m.uci() for m in b.move_stack))
send('go movetime '+str(int(float(sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv)>1 else 30)*1000)))
for l in f:
 if l.startswith('info depth'):
  depth=int(l.split()[2])
  if depth>=18:print(l.strip(),flush=True)
 if l.startswith('bestmove'):
  print(l.strip(),flush=True);break
send('quit')
PY
